text.tspan: The same three dependent steps, written three ways. Only the shape of the code changes.
Each level needs its own error check.
Reads top to bottom, like sync code.
All three do the same work on the same event loop. async/await is not a new mechanism: an async function
returns a promise, and every await is a .then() the engine writes for you.
